title: 第十七章 论炼丹与烹饪的宏观区别第十八章 好耶是大冒险
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 今日过的十分充实，回到源述峰解清玄想着段莫弃应当还在洞府里修炼，便要趁着天还未亮，去她仙府中的舒适小床上躺一会儿。
谁成想，她刚迈进小院便探到了房间内段莫弃的灵力气息。
解清玄揪着头发一阵无声哀嚎：‘房间又被占了！’
平复下来后她还是转身往洞府走去。
洞中，她与那冰冷石板对视半晌，还是嫌弃地摇摇头退后开来。
反正天都快亮了，干脆不睡了。只要精神状态稳定，她元婴的身子板儿熬上十天半个月的也不是问题。
解清玄的纳戒之中有个小型玉炉，可供炼制些简单的丹药。她在主室中寻了个平坦的地方摆上丹炉，拿出刚得来的材料，对照着原主的丹方笔记开始尝试料理。
炼丹与烹饪的区别应当不大。
上辈子她还蛮擅长对着菜谱做菜的，也是托这个天赋的福，她在实验室里按照师兄师姐传下来的实验流程跑实验的成功率也很高。如今这丹方和菜谱看着更为相像，且流程步骤不如她上辈子做的那些实验，想来炼制这【滋体丹】对她来说不会太难。
“将三棵【蛇毒果】碾碎出汁放入炉中，灌入平缓灵力先行熬制，随后加入小块【土根】与银粉，加大灵力输入辅助丹药塑性，最后在火候适当之时加入少许【璧泉花粉】与【火树枯叶粉末】作为调和。”
“维持微弱灵力与常火炼制五个时辰后，【滋体丹】自成……”
解清玄摇摇头，“大块”，“适当”，“少许”这些模棱两可的描述可真是太经典了……实验报告要是写成这样绝对第二天就会被劝退！
原主虽然在用药剂量上有笔记补充记录，但对于灵力的输出兴许是不好描述，所以他也没细写。
解清玄已经很知足了，总之先试着炼一锅吧，李林给她的材料够她实验三次。其中只要有一次成功，能出一颗【滋体丹】便够维持炼气弟子半年的肉身能量需求。
边做边记，解清玄很快就进入状态，全神贯注，沉浸式炼丹。
就在她做完前面比较复杂的操作，转入小火慢炖的时候，洞外传来了段莫弃的声音。
“师尊，早安。”
解清玄恍然抬头，怔怔活动了下脖子，淡蓝色天光从头顶那被渡劫雷电轰开的天井中倾泻而下，沁人心脾的清晨微风也从洞外贯通而来。
清晨有人问好，解清玄莫名觉得心情不错，下意识地也开口回应问候：“早啊，莫弃，你吃了……”吗？
她一拍脑门，赶紧把有降比格的话吞了回去，声音降了几分热度改口成：“你迟了……”
虽然但是，今天依旧是仙气飘飘的冰山美人师尊呢！
“……”段莫弃诚恳道歉：“师尊恕罪。”
解清玄等了几秒，没听到段莫弃进洞的脚步声便立刻明白了，赶紧波澜不惊地淡然开口招呼：“还不快进来修炼？”
“多谢师尊。”
待段莫弃在主室角落盘腿坐好开始吐纳，洞中的气氛又尴尬了起来。
解清玄因为害怕多说多错暴露自己是个修仙小白的事，所以除了交代正事，或者段莫弃主动发问，她这十来她与段莫弃是一句正常的天都没聊过。
content_en:
I had a very fulfilling day today. When I returned to Yuanshu Peak, Xie Qingxuan thought that Duan Moqi should still be practicing in the cave, so he decided to go and lie down on the comfortable little bed in her fairy mansion before dawn.
Unexpectedly, as soon as she stepped into the small courtyard, she detected Duan Moqi's spiritual energy in the room.
Jie Qingxuan pulled his hair and cried silently: 'The room is occupied again! ’
After she calmed down, she turned around and walked towards the cave.
In the cave, she stared at the cold stone slab for a long time, then shook her head in disgust and backed away.
It's almost dawn anyway, so I might as well not sleep. As long as her mental state is stable, it is not a problem for her Nascent Soul body to survive for ten days and a half.
There is a small jade furnace in Xie Qingxuan's Najie, which can be used to refine some simple elixirs. She found a flat place in the main room to set up the alchemy stove, took out the ingredients she had just obtained, and started to try cooking based on the original owner's alchemy notes.
There shouldn't be much difference between alchemy and cooking.
In her previous life, she was quite good at cooking according to recipes. Thanks to this talent, she also had a high success rate in running experiments in the laboratory according to the experimental procedures passed down by her senior brothers and sisters. Now the recipe looks more similar to the recipe, and the process steps are not as good as those experiments she did in her previous life. She thinks it won't be too difficult for her to refine this [Nourishing Body Pill].
"Crush the juice from three [Snake Venom Fruits] into the furnace, pour in gentle spiritual power and boil it first. Then add small pieces of [Earth Root] and silver powder to increase the input of spiritual power to assist the plasticity of the elixir. Finally, when the heat is appropriate, add a little [Biquan Pollen] and [Fire Tree Dead Leaf Powder] as a blend."
"After maintaining the weak spiritual power and refining it with constant fire for five hours, the [Body Nourishing Pill] was formed by itself..."
Xie Qingxuan shook his head. The ambiguous descriptions of "large", "appropriate" and "a little" are so classic... If the experiment report was written like this, he would definitely be dismissed the next day!
Although the original owner had supplementary notes on the dosage of the medicine, it might be difficult to describe the output of spiritual power, so he did not write it down in detail.
Xie Qingxuan was already satisfied. Anyway, she would try to make a pot first. The materials Li Lin gave her were enough for her to experiment three times. As long as one of them is successful, one [Body Nourishing Pill] can be produced, which can sustain the physical energy needs of the Qi Refining disciple for half a year.
Taking notes while doing it, Xie Qingxuan quickly got into the mood and concentrated on refining alchemy immersed in it.
Just when she finished the more complicated operations and turned to low heat to simmer, Duan Moqi's voice came from outside the cave.
"Master, good morning."
Jie Qingxuan suddenly raised his head and moved his neck in a daze. Light blue skylight poured down from the patio above his head that was blasted open by thunder and lightning. The refreshing morning breeze also penetrated from outside the cave.
Someone said hello in the early morning. Xie Qingxuan felt in a good mood for some reason, and subconsciously responded to the greeting: "Good morning, Mo Qi, have you eaten..."?
She slapped her forehead and quickly swallowed back the words that meant lowering the scale. Her voice became less intense and she changed her words to: "You're late..."
Although, today the iceberg beauty Master is still full of fairy spirit!
"..." Duan Moqi apologized sincerely: "Master, forgive me."
Xie Qingxuan waited for a few seconds and understood immediately when he didn't hear Duan Moqi's footsteps entering the cave. He quickly said hello calmly and calmly: "Why don't you come in and practice soon?"
"Thank you, Master."
When Duan Moqi sat cross-legged in the corner of the main room and began to breathe, the atmosphere in the cave became awkward again.
Because Xie Qingxuan was afraid of making too many mistakes and exposing herself as a novice in cultivating immortals, she had never had a normal conversation with Duan Moqi in the past ten years, except when explaining business matters or when Duan Moqi took the initiative to ask questions.
title_en: Chapter 17: On the Macroscopic Differences between Alchemy and Cooking Chapter 18: Yes, It’s a Big Adventure
